These are stair treads seen from above, descending away from the viewer. No riser or south face is drawn with its own tone, and there is no eave shadow. The bands are all tread-like, so no front face of 3+ rows exists. The drawing is a flat plan view of steps rather than a standing volume. This is a terrain tile, so the shape is acceptable as a stair autotile, but it has no separate front face.
